title: Several Credits Standing on a Micro Market Agreement, and How Much is Set Against the Settlement
content:
Where several credits stand on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement over the recent two months, only a share of them is set against the settlement being tendered, and the balance standing unsettled on the agreement settles which share.

## Conditions and shares

**The partial credit share of 60 per cent** is set against this settlement, and the rest is left to the next, where at or above 2 credits stand on the agreement over the two months to the day the payment is taken, and the balance standing unsettled on the agreement is below the minimum funding lot printed against the market format.

**The greater credit share of 80 per cent** is set against this settlement, and the rest is left to the next, where at or above 2 credits stand on the agreement over those two months, and the balance standing unsettled on the agreement is at or above the minimum funding lot printed against the market format.

**Where fewer than 2 credits stand on the agreement over those two months**, no such reduction of the credits is made.

## The boundaries

The several-credits count is 2 credits standing over the two months to the day the payment is taken: exactly 2 meets it, 1 does not. The balance standing unsettled is compared with the minimum funding lot printed against the market format, a balance standing exactly at that figure counting as at or above it.

*Hypothetical.* Three credits totalling 900.00 USD standing over the two months, with 1200.00 USD unsettled on the agreement against a printed minimum funding lot of 4200.00 USD, put 540.00 USD against this settlement and leave 360.00 USD to the next. Had 6000.00 USD been standing unsettled, 720.00 USD would be set against this settlement and 180.00 USD left to the next.
